# archgram

> Aesthetic architecture diagrams, straight from the code. archgram is an open-source CLI tool for software architecture diagrams. Write a YAML or JSON spec, or let Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini CLI draw one from your code. It writes one self-contained SVG that follows light and dark mode and animates the path a request takes. The file drops into a GitHub README or any docs page, and the animation plays wherever an image shows.

- Install: `npm install --save-dev archgram`; draw: `npx archgram build <spec>`; check: `npx archgram check <spec>`; print the spec format: `npx archgram spec`.
- The output needs no script, server or web font, and the same spec gives the same bytes on every machine.
- License: MIT.
